errors.evidence: In the FineWeb-Edu Classifier chart, Teaching & resources is about 17%, so this is acceptable; however the description later assigns several other values incorrectly, and the most explicit numeric error is that Health & Medicine is described as approximately 22% even though it is about 19%.
The figure shows Health & Medicine in the FineWeb-Edu Classifier chart at about 19%, not 22%.
Diseases is labeled 10 in the figure, not a range of 10-11%.
Nutrition is about 7% in the figure, but the color is blue/light blue, not purple.
Animal & Plant is about 12% in the figure; the color is red/pink, not dark red.
The figure shows one Materials slice in the outer ring at 3 and another at 1; the description conflates them and gives an imprecise incorrect range for the brown slice.
Historical review is labeled 12 in the figure, not a range of 7-12%.
Events & people is labeled 2 in the figure, not a broad range of 2-6%.
Infor tech is labeled 3 in the figure, not a range of 3-5%.
Emerging tech is labeled 4 in the figure, but its color is brown/salmon in the chart, not light blue.
There is no category named Fin & Engineer in the FineWeb-Edu Classifier chart; the small blue slice is Manage 1 in the outer ring and the inner wedge is Tech & Engineer 8.
The figure labels the inner category as Tech & Engineer 8, not a range of 8-12%, and its color is brown/salmon rather than dark cyan.
Manage is labeled 1 in the figure, not 1-2%, and its color is blue, not grey.
The chart labels this slice as Healthy education 2, but its color is green/teal like the other education slices, not light cyan.

errors.text_span: The chart appears to be arranged with segments generally ordered by decreasing proportion, though this is not strict.
errors.evidence: The figure does not present the slices in a clear decreasing-order arrangement; the pie is a sunburst-like hierarchical chart with categories placed around the circle according to grouping, not sorted strictly by size.
The description does not mention that this is a hierarchical sunburst/pie chart with inner and outer rings, which is essential structure visible in the figure.
The description omits that the chart has two panels side by side and that labels are connected to outer slices with leader lines.
